items.title: 3.6 Law of conservation of angular momentum (angular momentum qaim rehne ka law) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.6 with Figs. 3.18 to 3.23 (PDF 68-71).

blocks.text: Agar kisi system par koi external torque na lage to system ka kul angular momentum constant rehta hai.
blocks.title: Angular momentum ke conservation ka law

blocks.text: Yeh law physics ke basic principles (bunyadi qaidon) mein se hai. Yeh universe ke bohat bare (cosmological) level se le kar atom se bhi chhote (sub-microscopic) level tak sahi sabit hua hai. Is ka asar sab se saaf tab nazar aata hai jab koi akela ghoomta object apna moment of inertia badalta hai.

Khari (ruki hui) cycle par baithne ki koshish karein to woh gir jati hai. Lekin chalti cycle ke ghoomte pahiye ka angular momentum change ko resist karta hai (rokne ki koshish karta hai) aur cycle ko seedha aur stable (mazbooti se khara) rakhta hai.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.text: Agar moment of inertia I₁ wala object angular speed ω₁ se ghoom raha ho aur apna moment of inertia I₂ kar le, to us ki angular speed bhi badal kar ω₂ ho jati hai, taake angular momentum wahi rahe:
Jab dori ungli ke gird lipat-ti hai to gend ki speed barhti jati hai.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.alt: Haath ki index finger (shahadat ki ungli) oopar. Ungli ke gird lipti dori ek gend tak jati hai. Halki copies pehle ki haalatein dikhati hain jab dori lambi thi; abhi ki gend, sab se chhoti dori par, us ki motion (chalna ya hilna) ka teer rakhti hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 68): dori ungli ke gird lipatne par gend ki speed barhti hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Dori lipatne se gend ka radius chhota hota hai, is liye moment of inertia kam hota hai. Angular momentum wahi rehne ke liye angular velocity barhti hai, aur gend tez ghoomti hai, bilkul skater ki tarah.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Angular momentum vector hai jis ki direction rotation (ghoomna) ke axis ke saath hai. Is liye axis ke saath angular momentum ki direction bhi fixed rehti hai:
Kisi cheez ke rotation ke axis ka rukh (orientation) tab tak nahi badalta jab tak koi outer torque use na badle.
blocks.title: Rotation ka axis

blocks.text: Yeh baat Zameen ke liye bohat important hai. Suraj ke gird ghoomti Zameen par koi khaas (noticeable) torque nahi lagta, kyunke us par sab se bari force Suraj ki attraction (kheenchne ka asar) hai (jo centre ki taraf hai). Is liye Zameen ka axis universe ke hisaab se ek hi direction mein fixed rehta hai.
